topic: Pongal and Deepavali season: planning festival spending without derailing your SIP
judge_note: The best candidate was local but scored about 7 because its subhead was generic. A concrete festival scene lifts it.

slides.headline: Pongal sarees, sweets, gifts. SIP date still the 15th.
slides.subhead: Keep festival money and SIP money in two separate pots, and enjoy both.

points.title: Pot 1: SIP locked
points.text: Same date, same amount. If your SIP is the 15th, that date never changes.

points.title: Pot 2: Festival money
points.text: Bonus, extra savings, Diwali allowance. This is separate. This can flex.

points.title: Decide before spending
points.text: Before festival season, write down: how much is for investing, how much for celebration.

slides.headline: Plan this before Pongal arrives.
slides.cta: Save this. Show it to Amma or spouse today.
slides.footnote: Two pots. Two rules. No conflict this season.

caption: Festival and investing are not enemies. They are separate conversations. Pongal money, Deepavali money, and your SIP date all exist in the same season. How does your family split them? Share in comments.
